key_insight: The paper combines semi-smooth Newton solvers with POD, neural-network corrections, and hyper-reduction to efficiently solve nonlinear parametric variational inequalities in mechanics.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster surrogate simulation of obstacle and frictional contact problems while preserving mixed primal-dual physics and complementarity constraints.
method: Build POD reduced bases from primal and dual snapshots for linear reduced-order models.
Augment truncated POD coordinates with two feedforward neural networks to form a nonlinear manifold approximation.
Apply sparse cubature hyper-reduction via greedy nonnegative least squares to cut residual-evaluation cost online.
evidence_signal: The approach is validated on a 2D obstacle problem and a 3D frictional contact problem, comparing full-order, linear reduced, neural-augmented, and hyper-reduced variants.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of snapshot coverage and on careful coupling between hyper-reduction and the learned nonlinear manifold.
paper_title: A Hyper-Reduced Neural Network-Augmented Semi-smooth Newton Method for Nonlinear Parametric Variational Inequalities
